definitions.explanation: The act of saving or being saved from danger, suffering, or despair. Can be concrete (physical rescue) or abstract (spiritual salvation, emotional relief).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{救|すく}いになった。
examples.english: His words were a source of comfort.

examples.japanese: {救|すく}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the church seeking salvation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦せめて→せめて：10344_semete⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{救|すく}いだった。
examples.english: In the midst of a dark story, seeing hope at the end was at least some consolation.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb ⟦{救|すく}う→救う：02063_sukuu⟧ (to save, to rescue). Often used in emotional or spiritual contexts. The phrase ⟦せめて→せめて：10344_semete⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{救|すく}い means "at least some consolation" or "the one saving grace," and is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救|すく}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek salvation/help
- {救|すく}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧: a helping hand
- ⟦せめて→せめて：10344_semete⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{救|すく}い: at least some consolation
- {救|すく}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: hopeless, beyond help

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧: rescue (physical, more official)
- ⟦{救済|きゅうさい}→救済：12928_kyuusai⟧: relief, aid (institutional, formal)
- {慰|なぐさ}め: consolation, comfort (emotional)
